title: How PC component compatibility works
description: Test graph-RAG's ability to explain the compatibility model using ontology structure.
query: How does the system determine whether PC components are compatible with each other?

title: Compare available GPUs
description: Test retrieval of GPU specifications and comparison across key attributes.
query: Compare the available GPUs — what are the key differences in price, VRAM, and power requirements?

title: Product catalog overview
description: Test graph-RAG's ability to summarise the product catalog structure.
query: What categories of products are available, and how many products are in each?

title: Hard vs soft compatibility constraints
description: Test retrieval and explanation of the constraint model.
query: What are the hard and soft compatibility constraints, and what happens when one is violated?

title: Outdoor gear catalog summary
description: Test retrieval of non-PC product categories.
query: What outdoor and camping gear is available, organised by subcategory?

title: Product alternatives and accessories
description: Test traversal of alternativeTo, worksWellWith, and isConsumableFor relationships.
query: Which products are alternatives to each other, and which products work well together?
